svg.title: Projection paradigms and region-guided expert transformer workflow
svg.desc: Four horizontally arranged base frames: (a) mainstream projection paradigms with a vertical feature plane, BEV grid and projected cuboids; (b) depth-guided dual-projection view transformer with feature plane, BEV grid, highlighted cell, 3D scene traces and curved projection arrow; (c) regional partitioning strategy with camera rays, colored BEV regions and stacked partitions; (d) region-guided expert transformer and recursive variant with colored expert tokens, routers, voxel cube and recursive routing.

g.desc: Origin is the BEV grid. Up-left is a vertical feature plane; inward are projected translucent cells and cuboids. A right-facing arrow links to panel b. Symmetry basis: shared perspective grid with aligned vertical cuboid columns.

Origin is the center orange BEV cell. Up-left is the feature plane; rightward is a drawn outdoor point-cloud/road scene. A curved arrow returns depth guidance into the grid. Symmetry basis: dual projection shares the same BEV perspective lattice as panel a with a larger scene branch.

Origin is the colored BEV partition grid. Upward and rightward are multiple camera/expert icons projecting translucent triangular fields into the grid; a vertical stack of colored cuboids sits on the right side. Symmetry basis: radial camera partitioning around shared BEV regions, not uniform symmetry.

Origin is the left colored voxel cube. Rightward arrow enters a transformer block of six expert icons and a router; another arrow connects to a recursive variant with person icon, cube cluster, circular feedback arrow and router. Symmetry basis: two routing stages aligned horizontally with vertically paired expert rows.
g.text: (d) Region-guided Expert Transformer and its recursive variant
